title: Chart Procurement Analyst
jd:
To learn more about Arkansas Blue Cross and Blue Shield Hiring Policies, please click here . Job Summary The Chart Procurement Analyst coordinates the retrieval of medical records for initiatives related to risk adjustment, documentation and coding accuracy and quality measures. The incumbent is responsible for collecting, organizing, and analyzing medical records data. This includes using provider information to create reports about how to streamline the collection and internal sharing of patient records. This position is a liaison between healthcare organizations, copy service vendors, internal departments and the risk adjustment team. This position will work closely with provider network, collaborative health integration, primary care, and quality departments to ensure program efficiencies and streamlined provider communication, collaboration and education as applicable. Requirements EDUCATION Bachelor's degree Business or Healthcare management related field. In lieu of degree, five years’ health related non-clerical experience with an insurance, managed care or healthcare organization will be considered. EXPERIENCE Minimum three (3) years' analysis, research and/or medical coding experience. Minimum two (2) years' medical record review experience. Possess knowledge of the EMR (Electronic Medical Records) systems or electronic data sources. Knowledge of HL7, FHIR, etc. preferred. Knowledge of Risk and Quality concepts, related to Medicare Advantage and Affordable Care Act populations preferred. Knowledge of Visio or flowcharting software preferred. ESSENTIAL SKILLS & ABILITIES Organizational Planning Interpersonal Communication Microsoft Excel Reasoning Analyze Information Active Listening Motivated self-starter Electronic Medical Record (EMR) software Medical Record Reviews Proficiency working with MS Office Suite, such as Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Proficiency with MS Access, MS Project, and SharePoint software preferred. LOCATION Work from home within Arkansas Work Schedule: M-F Travel: Some local travel may be necessary to go to provider offices to retrieve records. Skills • Active Listening

• Retrieves, analyzes, coordinates, monitors and conducts reporting of medical records to ensure success of chart retrieval aspects Certifications Hiring Range Security Requirements This position is identified as level three (3). This position must ensure the security and confidentiality of records and information to prevent substantial harm, embarrassment, inconvenience, or unfairness to any individual on whom information is maintained. The integrity of information must be maintained as outlined in the company Administrative Manual. Segregation of Duties Segregation of duties will be used to ensure that errors or irregularities are prevented or detected on a timely basis by employees in the normal course of business. This position must adhere to the segregation of duties guidelines in the Administrative Manual.
